sources.institution: KU, KUMC, K-State, Wichita State, Emporia State, Pittsburg State, Fort Hays State plus all state agencies

sources.institution: All state agencies incl. Regents universities

sources.coverage_years: FY2006-present (site states); prior-year employee compensation in Data Download Center

notes: Used the KansasOpenGov CSV as best source despite being third-party, because the official KanView forbids crawling. Did not download the full CSV.
